forbidden: No shorts, no Phase 40/42 retrofit, no VWAP, no DVP 15m drift, no RSI/MACD/ADX, no holdout tuning, no freeze, no cash/ETF substitutes.
thesis: BULLISH STATE -> LONG; NON-BULLISH STATE -> FLAT. Never BEARISH -> SHORT.

distinct_from.phase40: Two-sided TSMOM closed. Phase 44 is a new long-only state model, not TSMOM minus shorts.
distinct_from.phase42: HTF 1h pullback closed. Phase 44 state is prior-session multi-day, not completed 1h return.
distinct_from.dvp: No VWAP, no 15m hour-return drift, no 80-pt stop. Prior-session 20d state only.

signal_series: Databento ohlcv-1d .v.0. Lookback uses roll-cleaned close-to-close (Phase 40 mark_rolls: instrument_id sidecar else 8x median overnight AND 80 bps). Sunday Globex stubs dropped.
state_at: Completed prior session. Current RTH cannot see today's unfinished daily bar.

primary_state.rule: 20-session roll-cleaned return ending at prior completed close > 0 => BULLISH next session, else FLAT.

primary_intraday_baseline.rules: If prior 20d > 0, buy next RTH 09:30 open +/- 1 tick, flatten 15:55. Long only.

primary_intraday_candidate.rules: Prior 20d > 0. First completed red 5m after 09:30, then first completed green 5m. Enter next 5m open +/- 1 tick. Stop = pullback low - 1 tick. 1R tracked independently. No new entry after 15:00. Flatten 15:55. Max 1/day. Never short.
primary_intraday_candidate.reason: Locked before Phase 44 P&L. Pullback is not a rescue if the open-long baseline is negative.

mode2.note: Diagnostic overnight. Not the prop primary.

always_long_benchmark: Required. If the filter does not improve return/risk vs buying every RTH, status is LONG_DRIFT_BETA_ONLY.
note: Phase 44 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if LONG_ONLY_EDGE_FOUND.
